page.overview:
What is Mayor of the Shire?

The Mayor of Michel Delving, or more extensively the Mayor of the Shire, was an important title among the Hobbits of the Shire.

It was an elected position held for seven years and its holder the most important leader of the Shire. The mayor also presided over large events where leadership was required.

The Mayor of Michel Delving was elected for seven-year terms. He was the only official in the Shire to be elected, unlike the hereditary title of the Shire-thain. He was chosen at the Free Fair at the Lithe, held every seven years at the White Downs. His primary duty was to preside over banquets during Shire-holidays.

Its importance increased during the late Third Age, assimilating the roles of Postmaster and First Shirriff, until it became the most important position, and its holder the only real official, in the Shire; the position was therefore known as "Mayor of the Shire". The town of Michel Delving became the Shire's seat of government.
